headline: DAM Capital Advisors informs exchange about ESOP trust deed intimation
summary: Dam Capital Advisors Limited has submitted an intimation to the stock exchange regarding the trust deed of the DAM Capital ESOP Trust. This procedural filing relates to the company's employee stock option plan structure. Such disclosures are routine corporate compliance activities for listed entities. Indian retail investors see no immediate impact on share price or financial performance from this administrative update.
why_it_matters: No direct financial consequence for retail shareholders.
